purpose: Complete the first real customer SLA comparison using new generation-2 ontology semantic-model sources and native source-backed metrics.

sourcePacket.binding: Only recorded workspace/lakehouse identities may replace template placeholders. Preserve source measures and every definition part.

newOntology.name: TelcoIQ_Hero_Generation2
newOntology.sources: The three new smoke semantic models; never direct lakehouse substitution
promptRequirements: Only the three owned hero semantic models in this workspace.
Preserve source-backed metric identity and home table; do not copy source DAX as a replacement calculation.
Reconcile conformed site/account identities by verified keys, not names.
Preserve incident, service-site and contract validity intervals and source row grain.
Enterprise source measures own contract-month eligible/applied/residual credits and caps.
Incident selection narrows the affected contract cohort; it does not turn monthly credits into incident-specific attribution.
Finance revenue/margin is account-month; keep the financial priority result deduplicated.
Create real linked natural-language Rule objects, not merely rule-named annotations.
No GraphModel, source mutation, permission, tenant setting or capacity changes by the agent.
Preview and inspect proposed source bindings, native relationships, home-table metrics and rules before one matching application.

allowedOperationGroups: Nonmutating exact DEV identity/owned-resource/public-permission and service-contract discovery
Create a new finite shutdown schedule/binding for the existing published read+suspend-only runbook; Inspect and read back before one F8 resume
Create one isolated hero lakehouse, one loader notebook, three complete semantic models and one new generation-2 ontology in the owned workspace
Submit the loader once, maximum fifteen minutes, cancel the exact submitted job if exceeded; initial refresh each hero semantic model once
Capture actual source DAX/count controls and separate GA IQ/native MCP schemas and outputs for synthetic hero sources
Test the approved source-proxy definition on one disposable ontology clone, read back metric/source links and delete only its returned ID before selecting a GUI-only authoring route
Stage and install one bounded public certificate on the existing BFF; preserve other credentials and existing delegated permissions
Read actual native metrics/relationships/rules, normalize and review their execution bindings
Use the named Luna deployment for bounded real model-plan requests; run equally informed paired questions and fresh follow-ups
Capture answers, returned rows, source queries, completeness, actual runtime events, metric/source bindings and recordings
approvalStillRequired: Exact Entra delegated-permission additions, if existing consent is insufficient, require a separate preview before application
Any corrected source/model/ontology artifact outside the approved revision requires a reviewed correction rather than blind mutation retry
Original native ontology update or lossy round-trip is prohibited; new source/ontology items isolate the earlier proof
GitHub or other external publication is not included

limits.modelInputReservation: Full reviewed 1050000-token context bound; conservative long-context DataZone rate, no cached discounts
limits.estimateLimitations: Six active hours plus two-hour retry tail at previously verified 1.44 USD/hour. Native-agent and shared overage consumption remain unmeasured; operational cap is not a guaranteed invoice ceiling.

cleanup.capacity: Cloud-owned deadline suspend, exact shared F8 only; no delete/resize
cleanup.heroItems: Retain newly recorded owned hero IDs for the customer handoff; cleanup preview deletes only those owned IDs when confirmed
cleanup.credentials: New BFF certificate expiry is no later than this execution window; private key stays Windows-DPAPI protected outside repository/OneDrive
cleanup.model: Keep existing approved Luna cleanup deadline October 3 13:32 UTC unless separately renewed
cleanup.evidence: Private raw operational receipts and identifier-free customer captures; runtime never reads evaluator gold

successEvidence: Actual new ontology is backed by semantic models with native metrics, not an application-owned graph
Every native selected metric links to its actual source measure/home table and returned result
At least one real complex SLA question and one changed input produce new provider/source executions
Both comparison paths receive the same source preparation and equivalent business facts
Display actual correctness and path differences or an honest tie; no predetermined ontology win
Missing/partial data never becomes a complete financial total
